messages:
emma.hart: Quick question  about log redaction. If we reduce SIEM retention to 90 days by default, what's the standard for masked fields in exported snapshots? Need to ensure export consumers can still do triage.
frank.liu: We should have three export masks: none (for ops/legal), partial (mask PI except IDs), full (hash everything). Default partial unless approved.
nina.choi: Also require a sample check: exporter must produce a one-line sample record (redacted) that gets stored in the request ticket. It helps reviewers confirm data minimization.
sec-bot: Policy reminder: EXPORT-MASKING-2 mandates at least partial masking for third-party consumers.
emma.hart: OK. I'll add masking options to the retention form UI. Frank, can you draft the masking rules?
frank.liu: Will do. Also logging: any ticket-based unwrap must generate an audit entry that includes pre-image hash for verification.
ina.choi: Small ops request: include a scheduled reminder 7 days before expiry to the ticket owner. Helps with renewals.
emma.hart: Good. We'll include. I'll push the UI mock later today.
